nodes.name: certmanager_client.go
nodes.summary: Generated typed client entry point exposing Certificate, CertificateRequest, ClusterIssuer and Issuer clients plus REST client configuration.

nodes.name: certificate.go
nodes.summary: Generated shared informer and lister accessors for Certificate resources, including filtered informers with custom list options.

nodes.name: certificaterequest.go
nodes.summary: Generated shared informer and lister accessors for CertificateRequest resources, including filtered informers.

nodes.name: clusterissuer.go
nodes.summary: Generated shared informer and lister accessors for the cluster-scoped ClusterIssuer resource.

nodes.name: issuer.go
nodes.summary: Generated shared informer and lister accessors for Issuer resources, including filtered informers.

nodes.name: certificate.go
nodes.summary: Generated cache listers providing cluster-wide and namespace-scoped read access to Certificate objects.

nodes.name: certificaterequest.go
nodes.summary: Generated cache listers providing cluster-wide and namespace-scoped read access to CertificateRequest objects.

nodes.name: CertmanagerV1Interface

nodes.name: CertmanagerV1Client

nodes.name: IssuerInformer

nodes.summary: Shared informer implementation that watches Issuers with optional list-option filtering.

nodes.summary: Indexer-backed implementation of CertificateLister.

nodes.name: NewForConfig
nodes.summary: Creates a cert-manager v1 client from a REST config, wiring each resource client.

nodes.name: NewForConfigAndClient
nodes.summary: Creates a cert-manager v1 client from a REST config and a custom HTTP client.

nodes.name: NewForConfigOrDie
nodes.summary: Creates the client or panics, for use during process startup.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Creates the client from a RESTClient interface, mainly for tests and custom transports.

nodes.name: setConfigDefaults
nodes.summary: Applies cert-manager default group version and user agent to a REST config.

nodes.name: RESTClient
nodes.summary: Returns the underlying REST client used by all resource clients.

nodes.name: NewCertificateInformer
nodes.summary: Creates a shared Certificate informer with a lister for the given client, namespace and resync period.

nodes.name: NewFilteredCertificateInformer
nodes.summary: Creates a Certificate informer that applies custom list options before caching objects.

nodes.name: NewCertificateRequestInformer
nodes.summary: Creates a shared CertificateRequest informer with a lister for the given client, namespace and resync period.

nodes.name: NewFilteredCertificateRequestInformer
nodes.summary: Creates a CertificateRequest informer that applies custom list options before caching objects.

nodes.name: NewClusterIssuerInformer
nodes.summary: Creates a shared cluster-scoped ClusterIssuer informer with a lister.

nodes.name: NewFilteredClusterIssuerInformer
nodes.summary: Creates a ClusterIssuer informer that applies custom list options before caching objects.

nodes.name: NewIssuerInformer
nodes.summary: Creates a shared Issuer informer with a lister for the given client, namespace and resync period.

nodes.name: NewFilteredIssuerInformer
nodes.summary: Creates an Issuer informer that applies custom list options before caching objects.

nodes.name: NewCertificateLister
nodes.summary: Creates a CertificateLister backed by the given cache indexer.

nodes.name: Certificates
nodes.summary: Returns a namespace-scoped Certificate lister for the given namespace.

nodes.name: NewCertificateRequestLister
nodes.summary: Creates a CertificateRequestLister backed by the given cache indexer.

nodes.name: CertificateRequests
nodes.summary: Returns a namespace-scoped CertificateRequest lister for the given namespace.
